name: grainy-airbrush-city-illustration
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:
· MEDIUM: painterly digital illustration / airbrushed CGI render with an anime-realism feel, heavy uniform stippled grain baked over everything.
· GROUND: a desaturated wide-angle urban street — crosswalk, tram rails, tall weathered apartment blocks and power lines — under a flat salmon-pink washed sky.
· LIGHT: soft diffuse dusk light, low contrast, matte skin with airbrushed gradients rather than sharp highlights.
· SIGNATURE TREATMENT: painted face graphics around one eye — a small fish, dots and coloured markings — and cyan-blue tinted skin against a glossy red top.
· PALETTE: dusty salmon-pink and sepia city, cold cyan-blue skin, vivid lacquer-red garment, muted greys.
· TEXTURE: dense grainy speckle and print-like noise gives a photocopied, dreamy quality.
· MOOD: melancholic, quiet, cinematic loneliness in a decaying city.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
